decision.rationale: Promoted and cleaned up. The priority 4:2:0 512x512 batch-16 product improved from 21.080675-21.254977 ms (point 21.166724 ms) to 20.784920-21.026135 ms (point 20.909809 ms); the absolute 95% confidence intervals do not overlap. All seven cells whose checkpoint launch changed from one thread per block to 128 packed threads per block had lower treatment point estimates, with the largest gains on 4:2:2 and 4:4:4. The three below-threshold controls retained identical production code and exact launch geometry in both processes: restart-16 batch 16 and batch 1 moved by +1.21% and +0.58%, while the 64x64 control moved by +3.96%. These are disclosed cross-process run-noise controls, not candidate regressions; representative_regression_percent is therefore the maximum regression among geometry-changing workloads, which is 0.0%. Every A/B pair preserved its input and output SHA-256, checkpoint count, component workspace, dispatch count, and transfer bytes; coefficient scratch remained zero. Correctness probes covered 4:2:0 and 4:2:2 odd seams, caller-owned padded output, strict region and scaled rejection, and Auto CPU fallback. Stage values are the arithmetic mean of the first and repeated warm cached probe, converted from microseconds to nanoseconds; Criterion wall-time confidence intervals remain the product measurement. Static ptxas sm_89 evidence for PTX SHA-256 b90b1a97152d08e0fe9e153304dd53bb7062119f86529475cc2dbbfefe4fc9e1 reported fast420/422/444 at 72/64/48 registers, 896/768/704-byte stack frames, and zero spill stores or loads; no shared-memory value was emitted. Nsight Compute 2026.1.1 hardware counters were unavailable because the driver returned ERR_NVGPUCTRPERM, so no dynamic traffic, occupancy, spill, shared-memory, or cache estimate is claimed. The later cleaned single-path priority rerun produced 20.397766-21.151019 ms and reproduced the exact hashes, geometry, zero scratch, diagnostics, and conformance evidence. The corpus digest is SHA-256 over domain `P19-CUDA-JPEG-DECODE-CORPUS\0`, followed in exact workload order by LE64(32) and the 32 binary bytes decoded from each cell input_sha256, retaining all ten cell digests including repeated source semantics. The historical A/B environment variable records baseline=1 and treatment=unset and has no effect after cleanup.
